invariants.rationale: A valid operation on context would require that it is non-null.
instantTime is likely expected to represent a point in time, which should not be null.
instantTime is a String, and its empty state partitions all possibilities. This expression is always true if instantTime is non-null.
The length of a String is always non-negative if instantTime is non-null.
The hashCode of context remains consistent during the method entry if context is non-null.
